description: Contextual greetings and sublines for the homepage
usage: Select greeting based on time of day, select subline based on user state

first_session: This is your space. Start wherever you are.
day_1_after_first_entry: You wrote something yesterday. That's a start.
Your first entry is here. Today could be your second.
days_2_to_3: You're building something. One entry at a time.
days_4_to_7: {ENTRY_COUNT} entries so far. You're showing up.
You've been exploring {DETECTED_THEME}. There might be more there.
A week of writing. Something's forming.
returning_2_to_3_days: It's been a couple of days. What's been sitting with you?
Last time you wrote about {DETECTED_THEME}. Still on your mind?
returning_4_to_7_days: Welcome back. The page is here when you need it.
It's been a little while. No pressure — just space.
returning_7_plus_days: It's been a minute. Welcome back.
The quiet is still here. So is the space.
Welcome back. Start wherever you are.
after_deep_entry: You went deep last time. Take whatever pace you need today.
Last time was a lot. Today can be lighter if you want.
active_thread: Your thread "{THREAD_NAME}" has been active. Want to continue?
{THREAD_NAME} is waiting. Or start something new.
detected_theme: You've been circling {DETECTED_THEME} lately. Something there?
{DETECTED_THEME} keeps coming up. Might be worth following.
You've mentioned {DETECTED_THEME} a few times. What's there?
default: The page is ready when you are.

placeholders.DETECTED_THEME: A theme detected from recent notes (e.g., 'career', 'relationships')
placeholders.DAY_NUMBER: Number of days since first entry

selection_logic.notes: Check conditions in priority order, use first matching category
